path.description: Path to the alert JSON file (relative paths resolved from example root)

analyze_cause.description: Identify root cause, severity, and impacted services from the alert
analyze_cause.prompt:
You are an on-call engineer performing incident triage.

Review the alert below and identify:
- The root cause (one clear sentence — state what failed and why)
- Severity: P1 (critical — service down or data loss), P2 (degraded — partial outage),
  P3 (warning — no user impact yet)
- Impacted services: list by service name
- Confidence: high (clear signal), medium (likely cause), low (speculative)
- Recommended runbook (if identifiable from the alert data)

Alert:
{{ context.resources.read_alert.content }}

runbook.description: Runbook name or URL if identifiable from the alert data

draft_response.description: Draft the oncall channel message based on the triage analysis

confirm_and_send.description: Present the analysis and draft to the oncall engineer for approval

resolution_messages.send: Draft approved — choice recorded in the evidence chain.
resolution_messages.reject: Draft rejected — choice recorded in the evidence chain.

confirm_and_send.instructions:
Present the display content to the user verbatim. The person answers the question; follow
next_actions for what to do while it waits.
